business_problem: The Clinician needed to scale the authoring of healthcare outcome projects while enforcing PHI screening, licensing controls, and auditability across mixed workloads with very different latency and reasoning requirements.
solution_summary: The Clinician uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: The Clinician needed to scale the authoring of healthcare outcome projects while enforcing PHI screening, licensing controls, and auditability across mixed workloads with very different latency and reasoning requirements. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform hosts the hybrid model-routing architecture that serves the application’s nine production endpoints, serving as the serving layer. Gemini Pro handles complex reasoning and document extraction inside project-authoring workflows, serving as the compute layer. Gemini Flash supports high-volume, latency-sensitive tasks such as question drafting, serving as the compute layer. Cloud Run functions provide the serverless endpoint layer for the governed healthcare workflow, serving as the serving layer.
